d:
Indian Men’s Hockey Team salvages a point with a draw but loses in shootout against England in FIH Pro League
Intro: After an intense 2-2 draw over four quarters, India suffered a 1-4 shootout defeat against hosts England in the London leg of their FIH Pro League European tour. Dilpreet Singh (10' and 58') scored an impressive brace to salvage a point for the visitors, courtesy the draw in regulation time.
